_comment: Which Factorio version each fixture's ground truth was captured from.
This lives beside the fixtures rather than inside them because several are
verbatim copies of the game's own JSON structures (autoplace-can-be-disabled
is a flat dict keyed by control name, asserted key-for-key in catalog.spec.ts),
so an added metadata key would be data pollution, not annotation.
'evidence' grades how the version was established - 'inferred' is weaker than
'stated', and 'unknown' means nobody wrote it down. Do not upgrade an inferred
or unknown entry without re-capturing against a known binary.
Enforced by test/fixtureProvenance.spec.ts; report staleness with

autoplace-can-be-disabled.dump.json.evidence: UNDOCUMENTED - committed 2026-07-12, between the 2.1.9 and 2.1.11 eras; re-capture to establish

Originally captured on 2.1.11, as basisNoiseSeeding.spec.ts still states

The sigma/a/b tables in this fixture are binary-RE artefacts, not oracle-samplable; they stay pinned only indirectly, by those 512 values.
